title: A local retraction of canonical derived evaluation
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] with derived categories [def-pc-derived-category] on $X$ and every open. Let $K,N\in D(\mathcal O_X)$, let $U$ be an open, and let $P$ be a complex of $\mathcal O_U$-modules strictly perfect in the sense of [def-pc-perfect-complex]. Suppose given $e_K:RK\cong QP$, where $R$ is exact restriction. Put $H=R\mathcal Hom$ [def-pur-derived-internal-hom], $D=H(K,\mathcal O_X[0])$, and use the derived tensor of [def-pc-scheme-derived-tensor-structure]. Let $g:N\otimes^L D\to H(K,N)$ be the adjunct, for the fixed canonical family [def-pc-canonical-derived-tensor-hom-bijection], of the associator followed by $1_N\otimes\mathrm{ev}$ and the right unitor, where $\mathrm{ev}$ is the image of $1_D$ under that family. There exists $r:RH(K,N)\to R(N\otimes^L D)$ with $R(g);r=1_{R(N\otimes^L D)}$. Only this one inverse identity is asserted; no representative of N or comparison with a prescribed chain map is an input or a conclusion.

proof.text: Take the actual localization preimage F=Q.objPreimage(RN) and its object-preimage isomorphism. Apply strictlyPerfect_localHom_computations to P: Hom(P,-) preserves quasi-isomorphisms and the ordinary dual is K-flat.

Construct ordinary evaluation f from localEvaluationDegreeMap and localEvaluationDegreeMap_comm. Its component formula proves IsLocalOrdinaryEvaluation. Apply exists_exactSource_evaluation_local_comparisons with the just-proved Hom and dual hypotheses to obtain a,b and R(g);b=a;Q(f).
For every integer n, isIso_localOrdinaryEvaluation_degree proves IsIso(f.f n). HomologicalComplex.Hom.isIso_of_components makes f an isomorphism of complexes; localization preserves this isomorphism.

Set r=b.hom ; (Q.mapIso(asIso f)).inv ; a.inv. Substitute the comparison equation and cancel Q(f) with its inverse, then a.hom with a.inv. Associativity and these inverse equations prove R(g);r=1. No local section or upper comparison theorem is imported.

proof_origin.description: X2 formalized the inverse transport. Exact Hom from finite free retracts is proved by short-complex retracts; ordinary evaluation proves dual K-flatness directly by preservation of acyclicity. Only the generalized representative equation is split off, and it does not assert any evaluation inverse.

theorem exists_strictlyPerfect_evaluation_local_retraction (X : Scheme.{u})
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ U : X.Opens, HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U))]
    (K N : schemeDerivedCategory X) (U : X.Opens)
    (P : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U)) ℤ)
    (hstrict : Scheme.IsStrictlyPerfect X U P)
    (eK : (SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u}
      (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) U).mapDerivedCategory.obj K ≅ DerivedCategory.Q.obj P) :
    let R := (SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u}
      (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) U).mapDerivedCategory
    let H := derivedInternalHom (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.toRingedSpace)
      X.toRingedSpace.sheaf
    let D := H.obj (op K, 𝟙_ (schemeDerivedCategory X))
    let g := ((schemeDerivedTensorHomEquiv X) (N ⊗ D) K N).symm
      ((α_ N D K).hom ≫ N ◁
        ((schemeDerivedTensorHomEquiv X) D K (𝟙_ (schemeDerivedCategory X)) (𝟙 D)) ≫
          (ρ_ N).hom)
    ∃ r : R.obj (H.obj (op K, N)) ⟶ R.obj (N ⊗ D),
      R.map g ≫ r = 𝟙 (R.obj (N ⊗ D))
